vb_textbox.text: Ensure that you are as focused as you can be. Regardless of the mushrooms earned across all of the rounds, the ones you miss out on due to not hitting the space key will annoy you and will reduce your overall score. Beware of chasing and favouring particular patterns of characters, by look, colour and position, as there is not a clear and obvious way to understand if you can maximise your haul this way. Make use of the breaks as much as you can as it will help with focus, and your eyes will need the rest. Good luck!
